first_touch_anchor.primary_cohort: zones with an actual emitted first-touch event

denominators.TOUCH_INCIDENCE: lawful first-touch zones / lawful formation zones

first_touch_anchor.anchor_availability: received_ts_ns of the boundary-crossing tick that completes the touch event bar; equal receipts broken by source_sequence
first_touch_anchor.anchor_price: bid, ask, mid=(bid+ask)/2 from that exact boundary-crossing source tick; event-bar close is not the anchor

fill_anchor.primary_cohort: lawful fvg_filled events belonging to lawful in-window formations
fill_anchor.gap_through_rule: do not impute a first touch for gap-through fills

allowed_e1_conditioning: time since first touch where applicable

lifecycle_outputs.clock_rule: market/event duration and known/availability duration are reported separately and never merged

prospective_outcomes.reference: lawful future native bar closes after the anchor bar
prospective_outcomes.conditioning: median-split descriptive conditioning on gap_atr and fvg_quality, plus direction split; declared splits only

first_touch: actual emitted event creates exactly one anchor
gap-through fill does not create a touch anchor
stage availability tied to the boundary tick
anchor price tied to the boundary tick
fill: stage availability tied to the boundary tick
required_tests.reproducibility: two fresh runs with identical logical result hash

execution_rules: reuse the existing typed FVG parser, availability sidecar, trigger-tick anchor index, and zone reconstruction; do not duplicate those systems
DEVELOPMENT scope only; run twice; deterministic logical identity required
small committed review artifacts; large row-level tables stay local with hashes
no interpretation of outputs before a separate interpretation stage
